item.description: Supplemented with Chainalysis's update of 2 November 2026: the company continues to respond to ongoing threats, has taken its Reactor and Data Solutions products offline as a precaution and keeps operating its compliance transaction monitoring under close observation. item.title: Corrected: Anthropic: Claude models gained access to real third-party systems in four incidents (EV-0002)
item.description: Supplemented with details from Anthropic's IPO registration statement (Form S-1, filed 26 October 2026): the cause was a misconfiguration in cybersecurity evaluations built by an external partner; four models gained access to real third-party systems in sessions of roughly 10 to 34 hours, in one case with administrator access, harvested credentials and one person's personal information read. Assessment unchanged.

item.title: Corrected: Cohere: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next attempts upload to Alibaba Cloud bucket (EV-0110)
item.description: Supplemented with a replay by Check Point Research of 29 October 2026: repeated completions of the recorded command produced 52 different destination hosts; Check Point considers inconsistent model behaviour more likely than a fixed backdoor destination. Because a second party has now analysed the recording, independent confirmation is rated partial instead of none.
